body:
Username: SparkzMC 

Skype: paddy-SparkzMC

Pro's: decent with a sword and God with a bow (not being cocky), I am very modest and perform very well in scrims. I am also very active on Skype and on minecraft. I also have scrim experience.

Con's: GMT Timezone, I go on holiday (vacation) alot and I can only play after 12:00 GMT (midday), and I have an annoying older brother who yells when I am talking to other people. He is not there when I am scrimming though.

How often do you play:I play every day after 12 GMT as long as I am not on holiday. If I am not playing minecraft then I am more than likely to be on Skype.

Previous Teams: FS, Atomic, StormCloak, Predators, Family business, and Nodus.jar

My position is midfield / support

Thanks for reading

EDIT: I will be able to do the odd scrim in the morning. A trial with any clan would be much appreciate!
